IN_SPACE.detail: Keyboard space bound to the Main map Jump action. Fires once on press. Calls Jumping through PlayerController.OnJump.

IN_WASD.detail: WASD as a Vector2 composite on Move. Shift is held for Run. Both go into PlayerController state and the movement states.

IN_MOUSE.detail: Mouse delta on the Look action. Read by CameraController every Update, scaled by sensitivity. Ignored while Time.timeScale is 0.

IN_ATK.detail: MainHand action. Routed through OnAttack to CombatStateController.HandleAttackInput. Blocked during animations and cooldown.

IN_TW.detail: Toggles between Sheathed and Unsheathed. Blocked while an attack, sheathe, or draw animation is playing.

IN_K.detail: K on the UI map. UIInputController calls UIManager.TogglePanel for the talent wheel. Also pauses time.

IN_CLICK.detail: Left and right mouse buttons on the UI map. VirtualCursor reads them each frame and sends synthesized clicks into the UI Toolkit tree.

PC.detail: Implements IPlayerContext. Receives every player input and routes it. Runs the active movement state in FixedUpdate. Owns the state dictionary and local service registry.

PCSTATE.detail: String-keyed store that components use to talk to each other: JumpPriority, IsGrounded, IsRunning, IsWeaponDrawn, IsAttacking. Only some keys are read by another component.

PCSVC.detail: Per-player dictionary from type to component. Components call GetService<T> to get a collaborator. Filled in PlayerController.Awake.

JUMP.detail: Grounded jump and one double jump. Adds an impulse to the Rigidbody. Cooldown 0.1 s. Sets JumpPriority for 0.15 s to stop Movement fighting the jump.

MOVE.detail: Grounded and air movement. Sets Rigidbody.linearVelocity from input and the MoveSpeed stat. Applies a sticky downward force when grounded. Skipped while JumpPriority is set.

GC.detail: Sphere or ray cast under the player each FixedUpdate. Writes IsGrounded to the state dictionary. Coyote time 0.15 s lets a jump start just after leaving the ground.

RUNMOD.detail: While Run is held and the player moves, adds a MoveSpeed modifier from RunMultiplier. Removed when Run is released.

CAM.detail: Turns look input into camera rotation. Pitch is clamped to -80 to 80 degrees. Yaw is read by Movement so WASD is camera-relative. Locks and unlocks the cursor.

CINE.detail: Scene object that follows CameraTarget. Not in code, set up in the scene.

CSC.detail: Owns weapon state (Sheathed, Unsheathed, transitions) and attack timing. Attack cooldown 0.8 s. Force-sheathes the weapon when movement changes state.

ADISP.detail: Receives animator events by name and forwards them to registered IAnimationEventReceiver components.

PAC.detail: Writes Animator parameters (speed, direction, grounded) from state values IsRunning and IsGrounded. Does not read the jump keys.

AEH.detail: Scene-wired. On an attack impact, runs an overlap sphere in front of the player and calls IDamageable.TakeDamage. No IDamageable implementers exist in code yet.

GRAV.detail: Applies gravity every FixedUpdate. Reads GravityMultiplier and TerminalVelocity from StatsService. Clamps falling speed to the terminal velocity.

RB.detail: The Player physics body. linearVelocity and AddForce are written by four components (Jumping, Movement, GravityController, PlayerController). Final velocity depends on execution order.
